+    y = PAPER_LEFT_Y - (px + 0.5) * MM_PER_PX

+def append_segment(rows, start, end, max_step, hold=0):
+    start = np.asarray(start, dtype=float)
+    end = np.asarray(end, dtype=float)
+    n = max(1, int(math.ceil(np.linalg.norm(end - start) / max_step)))
+    for t in np.linspace(1.0 / n, 1.0, n):

+    hover = np.r_[start_xy, TRAVEL_Z]
